title: Terminal: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Terminal failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If a tab is absent, confirm the owning addon is loaded and reopen the terminal after resources reload.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If a tab is absent or stale, confirm the addon is loaded, reopen the terminal, check debug status, and verify the feature publishes a terminal surface.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
